subject.title: Make adaptive refresh agent-aware by default

question: Should an unset or invalid refresh preference silently opt existing users into Adaptive and periodic local process/transcript-metadata scanning?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes a persisted-settings fallback and expands background observation beyond the Agent Sessions opt-in boundary, so maintainer intent is required.

options.title: Preserve legacy unset users
options.body: Keep the five-minute fallback for existing unset preferences and enable Adaptive scanning only after explicit selection.

options.title: Fresh installs only
options.body: Add a tested installation marker so only provably new installations receive Adaptive by default.

options.title: Adopt for every unset user
options.body: Approve the compatibility and privacy change after packaged-app upgrade and runtime proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy unset users
recommendation.body: Keep the five-minute fallback for existing unset preferences and enable Adaptive scanning only after explicit selection.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged history shows direct ownership of both the scanner feature and its default-off product boundary.
